articles.title: NASA’s DART Mission Changed Orbit of Asteroid Didymos Around Sun
articles.summary: New research reveals that when NASA’s DART (Double Asteroid Redirection Test) spacecraft intentionally impacted the asteroid moonlet Dimorphos in September 2022, it didn’t just change the motion of Dimorphos around its larger companion, Didymos; the crash also shifted the orbit of both asteroids around the Sun. articles.title: Eutelsat completes $5.8 billion refinancing plan
articles.summary:
Eutelsat has completed the last step in a 5 billion euro ($5.8 billion) refinancing plan to refresh its OneWeb constellation and support Europe’s IRIS² sovereign connectivity program, the French satellite operator announced March 6.
The post Eutelsat completes $5.8 billion refinancing plan appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX plans mid-afternoon Falcon 9 rocket launch from Vandenberg SFB
articles.summary: The Starlink 17-18 mission will add 25 more satellites to SpaceX’s low Earth orbit megaconstellation. Liftoff from pad 4E is scheduled during a launch window that opens at 1 p.m. PST (4 p.m. EST / 2100 UTC).
